This sheet exists to show deviation from consensus as a budget: a ceiling, an amount taken, and what each condition did to it. On this run the amount taken is the full deviation, because positioning toward consensus is switched off by configuration. That makes the conditions below a record of what the system would have done — measured on real inputs, reported in full, and not applied. Reporting the positioning we declined is more useful than reporting none at all.
